fit.walk_forward_note: At least 120 earlier sessions per fit. Origin excluded from training. Endpoint Bitcoin and STRC given. Origin Bitcoin per share held fixed. Absolute miss as percent of actual MSTR. Overlapping horizons. 28 calendar day gap half life. mNAV cap 2.

model.target_description: Fitted Bitcoin line with STRC shortfall below par and mNAV capped at 2
model.btc_per_share_note: Bitcoin per share 0.0018774 on the last row, live from strategy.com when the row was added

backtest.mstx: 2.00 x MSTR daily minus about 0.26% a day
backtest.note: Headline cells, the cards and the chart all run at the config slope, 0.025. The slope sweep shows the same trade at other slopes. The 0.0125 slope is used by the lag signal only.

regime.note: MSTR cheap by 4 percent or more (8 percent on MSTX) at the 0.025 slope, split by BTC's state that day; STRC period, 285 days
regime.read: Cheap with BTC above its 50-day closed with MSTR rising. Cheap with BTC below it closed by BTC falling. Four episodes: a rule to trade by, not a proof; the monitor's log is the live test.
read_lines: Above the 50-day, cheap closed with MSTR rising. Below it, BTC fell instead.
Four episodes: a rule to trade by, not a proof.
